maximumLevelNumber._comment: Fixed one-based campaign/save-format boundary; changing it requires coordinated UI, QA and profile migration.

base._comment: Maximum bolts available for campaign index 0, independent of saved profile data.

perLevel._comment: Additional maximum bolts for each zero-based campaign index.

minimumSeconds._comment: Recovery allowance after the first attended arrival; there is no travel deadline.

maximumSeconds._comment: Upper bound on the recovery allowance in simulation seconds.

baseRobots._comment: Robots included before the extra-flock-size allowance applies.

extraRobotsPerSecond._comment: Each started group of this many extra robots adds one recovery second.

extraRouteSeconds._comment: Recovery seconds added for each route after the first.

journeyMetersPerStep._comment: Spawn-to-goal distance per complete journey allowance step, in world units.

journeySecondsPerStep._comment: Recovery seconds added for each complete journey-distance step.

maximumPoints._comment: Maximum whole-number wallet balance accepted while validating an existing save.
